purpose: Teach: 宮内庁/日夜/儲ける/コネ/ドロップ/修習/総数/産婆

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、宮内庁にお品を納めたお話、お聞きしたぞ
lines.en: I heard about the goods you delivered to the Imperial Household — your father did something remarkable there.
lines.style: Measured, warm reminiscence. Voice carries the weight of shared memory. Settles on key phrases with gentle authority. Slow enough to invite reflection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは日夜、社員のために尽くされました
lines.en: Yes. Father devoted himself to the company and its people every single day.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Respectful cadence — each phrase deliberate, honoring. Not defensive, just stating fact with understated pride. Slight pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは「儲けるだけが商売ではない」と仰った
lines.en: He used to say: 'Business isn't just about making money.' He believed in something bigger.
lines.style: Voice softens into memory. Distant, tender. Quotes with care — almost hearing his father's voice underneath. Trails gently, letting the idea linger.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはコネに頼らない経営をなさいました
lines.en: Yes. Father built the company without relying on connections or favors. He did it on principle.
lines.style: Reflective, steady tone. Each word carries understanding earned over time. Not boastful — just acknowledging what was real. Slow, respectful pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、苦境でも事業をドロップさせなかった
lines.en: Even when times were hardest, he never abandoned the business. He kept it alive.
lines.style: Voice carries both sadness and strength. Remembers struggle with quiet respect. Slight catch on 'hardest' — the weight was real. Recovers with steady resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、若い社員の修習にお時間を割かれた
lines.en: Yes. He spent his time training the younger staff. That mattered most to him.
lines.style: Warm recognition underlying the formality. Deliberate pacing — emphasizing 'spent his time' with quiet significance. Pride in what his father valued, not just what he built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは創業時、社員の総数を毎日、把握されてたぞ
lines.en: When we were just starting out, Father knew every single employee by name. He tracked it all himself, every day.
lines.style: Amazement threading through the memory. Voice quickens slightly with the intimacy of the detail. Genuine awe at the care required. Settles back into reverence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは産婆のように、若手を世に出されました
lines.en: Yes. He brought young people into the world like a midwife brings new life. With care, patience, purpose.
lines.style: This is the summation — voice finds full weight and clarity. Tender but assured. Metaphor lands with quiet power. Slight breathiness on the closing phrase, like a door closing gently on something sacred.
